# smc_sidewinder_logging_profile (Resource)

This represents a Sidewinder Logging Profile, which contains settings for logging in Sidewinder.

### Nested Schema for `sidewinder_logging_profile_setting`

Optional:

- `element` (String) This is the base class for all storable elements.
